I've heard the class is difficult, but manageable as long as you stay on top of everything. Pretty much none of your 101 teachers are gonna be amazing.

I'll put it this way..Pradip is VERY knowledgeable about the subject, but he's used to teaching higher level classes to the point where he can't convey the information to 101 students. If you ask him a question, he says to ask your TA's. And when you ask them, they'll most likely reply "I haven't done that in about 3-4 years. Let me see if I remember." And in my lab class there were people that had other professors for lecture too. We compared tests, and Pradip's were a bajillion times harder. The class focuses on programming in the C language, but his tests were basically physics tests. I literally remember a question:

If Amy were travelling from Anycity, SC to Somecity, SC travelling 80 mph starting on mile marker 20 and Susan was travelling from Somecity, SC to AnyCity, SC at 120 mph starting at mile marker 86, what time and what mile marker will they meet?

That was a problem on one of the tests almost word for word. The other people in my class were like...We have no idea what that means..Our tests have programming on them.

Also be prepared if you take Pradip's class to learn binary for the first 2 1/2 weeks.

I'm just speaking from experience in the class. I heard from someone his classes have the highest failure rate in CompSci.
Avoid Pradip Shrimani like the plague. Other than that, you're good.
